monitorFlipInterval.Description: Nominal screen flip interval measured by PsychToolbox
monitorFlipInterval.Notes: Recorded as the inverse of the monitor's refresh rate (e.g., ~0.0167 for 60 Hz)

onset_1.Notes: Short delay between scanner_starttime and presentation of first clip

onset_2.Notes: Short delay during transition between movie clips (e.g., onset_2 - offset_1)

onset_3.Notes: Short delay during transition between movie clips (e.g., onset_3 - offset_2)
